title: The Essayes of Francis Bacon, Easton Press 1980 Leather Bound HC
descriptionText:
This is a luxurious collector’s edition of “The Essayes” by Francis Bacon, part of Easton Press’s 100 Greatest Books Ever Written series. The book is in English, published by Easton Press in 1980, bound in leather.
Approximate dimensions: 10in x 11in x 3in (including slipcase/packaging). Weighs approximately 2lbs.
